meta.title: A live RFQ withdrawn by the buyer
warnings: added place_bid — the test is about bidding and no bid step was planned
added place_bid — the test is about bidding and no bid step was planned

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default Auction stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Verify the specified delivery location is shown in the sheet.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite two QA test vendors without naming or selecting a real supplier.
Publish the RFQ so it is live and can be withdrawn.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Use the RFQ stage Settings withdrawal action with the required remark.
Verify Procol records the RFQ as withdrawn.
Verify the expected withdrawal confirmation appears.
Return to the events list to verify the post-withdrawal listing.
Open the History tab where withdrawn events should appear.
Verify this plan's withdrawn RFQ appears in History.
Verify the event's History row has the Withdrawn status.
